title: RabbitMQ to AWS Lambda
description: Creates a Lambda function that is invoked by a RabbitMQ queue.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: The SAM template deploys a Lambda function, a RabbitMQ queue and the IAM permissions required to run the application. RabbitMQ invokes the Lambda function when new messages are available.
